_help: Add or remove entries here — each object in 'items' becomes a card on demo/index.html. 'href' is relative to the demo/ folder (use '../part-editor/' for a build hosted at /part-editor/). 'accent' picks the tile colour (purple | teal | pink | orange | sky | lav). 'icon' is a key from assets/js/icons.js. 'status' is 'live' (clickable) or 'soon' (shows as a dashed 'coming soon' card).

items.title: Part Editor
items.excerpt: Design custom LEGO parts right in your browser — import an LDraw library, build and tweak geometry, then export back to LDraw.
